The core finding is that the road cross-sections were never designed at 1.6 studs per metre. They were designed in 'car studs' (3/m) laid on a 1.6/m plan. What is wrong at player scale is the traffic lanes: 16 studs (5.3 m) on 2-lane sides and 13 studs (4.3 m) on 3-lane sides, against a real 3.3-3.65 m = 10-11 studs. That gives today's halves of 32 (undivided 2+2), 35 (divided 2+2) and 42 (divided 3+3); real-size targets are about 21-22, 24-25 and 33-35. Big new streets in network.py: 26 -> about 21, 39 -> about 32. Game 'street' half 16 -> about 10.

Most other constants are lengths ALONG the road (eases, gores, splits, section and median minimums, ring and corridor radii, pier spacing, seam tolerances). These should grow x1.875 to keep their real metres. Lane point spacing (24) and grid cells can stay.

notes:
I edited no files and did not run Studio or Blender. I only ran one Python script, from my scratchpad, that reads extents from geo.batch_poly and the terrain stats.

Main findings:
1) The projection itself is clean: one function, geo.world, with metres x SPM. But at least 7 private copies hard-code 30000 and 1.6: d10, d19, d20, d23, pilot_plots, YangonRoads.luau and YangonFar.luau. On top of that, d4/d6, YangonTerrain.luau, heights.py:255 and landmarks.py use 1.6 as the vertical scale.
2) Vertical scale VS = 1.6 equals SPM today, which is why the grades in heights.py are real. Going 1:1 means VS = 3 as well. Ground relief then doubles in studs (Shwedagon platform 93 to 174 studs), so YangonTerrain2.YTOP (200) and the probe ray start need headroom.
3) Extent: the batch union is 20,459 x 17,775 studs today (12.8 x 11.1 km). At 3 studs/m it is 38,361 x 33,328 studs, and with OX = 30000 that is x 16,766..55,126, z -14,396..18,932. That pushes western Yangon below x 25,000, which breaks six runtime 'X > 25000 = Yangon' tests and DayCycle.YANGON_X.
4) Roblox limits are not the blocker. Terrain MaxExtents is about ±128k studs, and float precision is about 0.004 studs at 55k. The real costs are terrain size (about 3.5x the tiles: roughly 20-30 M characters of tile data per batch), Studio write time, the cloud place-size limit already hit on 14 Nov, minimap tile count, and streaming radius / memory.
5) The vault master plan still says 'Scale stays 1.6 studs a metre' (master plan line 30) and needs updating to the 2026-11-16 decision. CLAUDE.md:136 already records it.
6) The minimap today covers batch 0.5 only (27 tiles). Rebuilt for the whole city, it should read all batches.
7) Car-scale road widths (half 32 / 16, the 14-stud deck in d6, WALK 10) are road-area items. They become real lane widths x 3, and the terrain beds follow them automatically through the road profiles.

Then this area:
1) plots.py <tag> (reads ygn_roads_v5 / roads_<tag>_profile.json, network_<tag>.json, osm_ygn buildings / areas, landmarks, YangonWorld lots; writes build/city/plots_<tag>.json + PNG).
2) bprobe.py prep <tag> -> Studio YangonProbe2.spawn pages -> join_pages.py -> bprobe.py apply <tag> (writes "y" into plots_<tag>.json; needs terrain + street collision in Studio).

Landmark-only cells still via d24_bmesh.py -> YangonBuildingMeshes.place / collide.
4) details.py <tag> (reads plots, streets + probe heights, v5 / profile roads, lanes, osm points / lines; writes details_<tag>.json, Details_<tag>_<n>.luau and, for batches, YangonLampSpots_<tag>_<n>.luau) -> details_test.py <tag> -> YangonDetails.spawn({tag}) -> YangonPoleLights.run() (0.5; batches carry lamps in their data).
5) Green: d20_green.py (0.5) / green.py <tag> (reads plots, streets, details_<tag>.json, osm) -> YangonGreen / YangonGreenBatch build -> M.lift.
6) Lamps: d16_lamps.py (0.5; reads v5, SITES, YangonWorld) / details.py lamps_batch -> YangonLamps / YangonLampsBatch (raycasts need pavements in place) -> L.farWindows.

pipeline_order:
1) Settle the constants first: SPM and VS in geo.py (copied into d10, d19, d20, d23, d6, d7, ground.py, heights.py, landmarks.srtm_y); OX and the 'is this Yangon' test (replace every x > 25000); STUDS_TO_MPH vs 3.0.
2) Roads, terrain and lanes (other area) -> the new road JSON (half, walk, lanes per sample), decks, roundabout, YangonLanes*.lua. Everything below reads them.
3) Reservations before buildings. The new shared site library (replacing the d10 head) reads the new roads plus the real landmark footprints (Shwedagon platform, Myanmar Centre, Sedona and others from geo.world(landmarks.json)). Then d11, d13, d14 and d17 pick the venue, tower, hotel, Rewards, Service and dropoff lots -> Config.YangonVenues and Config.Service. Then d15_world.py probe -> Studio height probe -> probe_out.txt -> d15 build -> YangonWorld.lua (house lots, races, dispatch/drops, chips, hub) + build/yangon_world/pads.json.
4) Plots and mesh buildings (plots.py -> bprobe -> d24_bmesh) with all of these reserved: venue, house, hub and landmark lots are left empty (YangonSites.prepare can no longer move mesh cells).
5) Landmarks. (a) Great landmarks: landmarks.py (geo centres, SH = SV, re-probed gy) -> .glb + <id>_data.luau -> Open Cloud upload -> YangonLandmarks.luau build / collide / pads / trees -> YangonFar stand-in. (b) Real-geometry landmarks: re-raster the lot from the new roads (lot_rays / road_grid / lot_fine) -> landmark_mc_fit.py -> mc3d.py and sedona3d.py (real floor heights) -> landmark_glb3d export with a new --plane measured in Studio -> upload -> LandmarkPlace3D (place, boards, signs, lights) + collide -> mall_life.py -> YangonStreetLifeMall.lua. The cells under them are rebuilt with d24_bmesh minus the dropped plots.
6) In Studio: YangonSites.prepare(Config.YangonVenues.Sites + pads.json) to level the pads; YangonSites.fuel / CareVenues for the fuel stations and Legends Service -> Config.Fuel.Stations and Config.Service. The venues (bank, dealership, customs, hotel, Rewards, gems, towers, houses, hub) build themselves at start from siteData; EntranceRamp lays the drives.
7) Lamps (d16) and green (d20) again, so they keep off the drives. Then the minimap (d12 -> upload -> YangonMapArt.lua).
8) Code literals: WestLayout.places ygn_*, Config.Spawn.YangonNear, ChallengeData.boardPos, menu orbit and MenuFocus, Towers telescope centre, DayCycle.YANGON_X and the other x > 25000 tests, WestLayout.kerbFor lane maths. Gameplay numbers: JobMinDistance, duel distances, chip spacing, race rewards, fuel station count.
9) Lune tests (world_test, graph_test, chauffeur_test), luau-lsp, Play test (spawn, every venue door and ramp, a race, a job, the chauffeur, fast travel to each ygn_ place), phone-size screenshots, and the quality-nerd check on the landmarks against the photos.

pipeline_order:
0. Prep (owner OK needed): save the parked/backups (YangonBatchesParked, YangonBuildings_step8/_realparts, YangonReplaced_*, YangonScraps, YangonData_v3backup) to .rbxm on disk and remove them. Record the baseline place size, Edit/Play memory and instance count. Pick the origin (OX) and whether the new map is built in a separate dev place.
1. geo.py SPM=3 (+ origin); ground.py / d5 / d6 / terrain_study VS=3; YangonRoads.SPM, YangonTerrain LAKE_Y; all the stud constants above changed to metres x SPM.
2. Data that needs no re-run (lon/lat or metres): build/osm_ygn (e0_extract), build/city/dem_ygn.json (dem_fetch), lane_survey_osm.json, look_bible.json, atlases, Blender/kit sources.
3. ground.py field (reads DEM -> heights at the new VS; re-export batch 0.5's ground in place of ygn_road_design.json).
4. Roads: roadnet.py (all roads, batch 0.5 included, if the 0.5 part roads are retired; otherwise d18 -> d23 -> YangonData.Roads* -> YangonRoads.step5) -> heights.py (decks, clearance) -> roadmesh.py / street_glb.py -> Open Cloud upload -> YangonRoadMeshes.place + roads.py / YangonStreetCollide collision boxes. Reads: osm_ygn, ground. Writes: roads_<tag>/*.glb, *_assets.json, RoadCollide_* modules.
5. Terrain: terrain.py (reads the road beds/decks + ground + water) -> Terrain<tag>_* modules -> YangonTerrain2.spawn (delete the modules after).
6. Lanes: d9_lanes.py (main) + roadlanes.py (batches) -> src/shared/YangonLanes*.lua (first = 189 after RivieraLanes) -> lune graph_test / world_test.
7. Plots: network.py -> plots.py <tag> -> bprobe (YangonProbe2 in Studio, join_pages) -> kit placer (replacing d24_bmesh per-cell meshes) -> YangonBuildingMeshes.place + collide. Reads roads (corridors) and ground.
8. Landmarks: landmark_mc_fit (raycasts on the NEW roads) -> mc3d / sedona3d / landmarks.py -> landmark_glb3d -> upload -> LandmarkPlace3D (+ YangonBuildingMeshes.collide); rebuild the replaced cells.
9. Green (green.py / d20 -> YangonGreen), lamps (d16 -> YangonLamps), details (details.py -> YangonDetails -> YangonPoleLights).
10. Lots and venues: d21_refit -> d11 / d13 / d14 / d17 sites -> YangonSites.prepare / fuel -> Config.YangonVenues.Sites, Spawn, Service, fuel pumps -> d15_world probe/build -> YangonWorld.lua; WestLayout.places ygn_*; Towers centre; EntranceRamp / Houses / DayCycle x-tests.
11. streetlife.py + mall_life.py -> YangonStreetLife*.lua.
12. Far LOD / YangonFar (Persistent, per district).
13. d12_minimap -> upload -> YangonMapArt.lua.
14. Test (Play, phone emulation, night), measure place size, memory and unique-mesh count, save, notes.
Repeat steps 3-14 per district (below), so the place saves after each.

District order (each step saved and measured before the next):
(a) Pilot: the Kamayut / Hledan / Inya-south core, about 2 x 2 km real (Myanmar Centre, Sedona, Optima, spawn, venues, races). At 3 studs/m that is about 6,000 x 6,000 studs, about the size of today's whole batch 0.5 core.
(b) Rest of batch 0.5 (Bahan, Mayangon, the lake ring).
(c) Batch 1 (west to the Hlaing, Shwedagon at true size).
(d) Batch 2 downtown: densest, 70-85% cover, most landmarks; heaviest per km2.
(e) Batch 3 east: largest (27.9 km2, 427 km of 1+1 streets); it may stay far-LOD plus main roads only if the budget runs out.

Budget gates per step: unique mesh assets map-wide at most about 3,000 (batch 0.5's 3,070 loaded cleanly; 15,537 did not); Studio Play at most 14 GB; the place file well under the size at which version 842 failed (measure that size first).

- Reusable unchanged: OSM extract, DEM, lane survey, the look bible and atlases, the 3D landmark scripts (re-run), car / street-life / tree / lamp kit models (already car-scale), DayCycle Yangon colours, PlayLight / Swatches.
- Reusable by scaling about the origin (P' = O + 1.875 (P - O) in x/z, y re-dropped to the new ground) only as first guesses, re-snapped after: point data (venue sites, spawn, fast travel, race checkpoints and chips, pumps, Service bay).
- NOT valid to scale: roads (widths would double to half 60), buildings (heights already right; bays and texture rows would stretch), terrain (voxel grid), collision boxes, lanes (re-sample), or any uploaded mesh asset. All of these must be regenerated at SPM 3.
notes:
Estimates for 1.875x per axis (3.52x area), assuming constants are moved to metres x SPM unless stated:
- Map extent: the batch 0.5-3 union grows from 20.5k x 17.8k studs to about 38.4k x 33.3k studs (x 16,766..55,126 about OX 30000). Area grows from 221 M to about 776 M studs2.
- Road meshes: road surface per km grows only about 1.4x (real lanes make roads narrower in studs while length grows 1.875x), but every length-tiled constant (GRID 16, BAND 3.2, STEP 8) gives 1.875x triangles if left. Batches 1-3 would go from 8.6 M to about 16 M triangles and 12.8k to about 45k unique meshes at CELL 256. With metre constants, texture kerbs and about 1 km cells: about 7-8 M triangles in about 600-900 meshes.
- Building count is unchanged (116k). Footprints in studs grow 3.5x and heights stay (12/9 per floor is already 4 m / 3 m), so 'too tall and thin' goes away. Wall triangles per building grow about 1.875x (12-stud bays become 4 m). The whole map moves from about 11.6 M to about 20 M building triangles, streamed. Unique-mesh count must come from a kit, not cells.
- Terrain: 4-stud columns grow from about 13.8 M to about 48.5 M, and fill depth about 1.875x with an absolute YB -24: the biggest save-size unknown. Use a thin skin.
- Collision parts: building boxes are scale-independent (about 20.5k for 0.5, 33.8k for B1). Street/road boxes grow 1.875x unless BOX_LEN goes to about 75.
- Lanes: about 2.1 MB of Lua becomes about 4 MB at STEP 24, or stays about 2 MB at STEP 45.
- Details and trees: 3.5x if budgets and spacings stay in studs (details.py:87, green.py:36): must be converted.
- Memory and phones: per stud2 the map gets about 3.5x sparser, so at the same StreamingTargetRadius clients hold less. Raising it to about 1024 keeps today's real view (about 340 m) at about today's instance load. The server and Studio Play still hold the whole map: whole-map instances, not radius, are the Studio 15.3 GB problem. Converting the 185.8k batch 0.5 road parts to meshes is the largest single saving.
- Load time on phones is driven by the number of unique asset ids requested (the 429 throttling) more than by triangles. Kit instancing plus about 1 km cells keeps it bounded.
- Found but not fixed: YangonBuildingMeshes.place (tools/yangon/YangonBuildingMeshes.luau:91-112) and YangonRoadMeshes never set CollisionFidelity = Box on the visual MeshParts (YangonLandmarks.luau:119 does). Imported hull/physics data is then saved in the place for every visual mesh: a likely save-size lever even before the rescale.
- The vault master plan's Decision 1 ('Scale stays 1.6 studs a metre') and Decision 5 (0.5 main roads stay part roads) are now obsolete and should be updated in the plan note.
- All of this is read-only research. Exact Roblox limits (place file cap, server memory cap) were not verified here.
